how_to_apply: Registration: Visit bceceboard.bihar.gov.in, go to the "Online Portal of Food & Civil Supplies Corporation Ltd." link, click "Apply Online", then "Click here for Registration". Fill in the required details using your own email ID and mobile number, as your Registration Number and Password will be sent there. Change your password on first login after registration.
Basic Details: Log in with your Registration Number and Password, complete the Basic Details section, and click Save & Next.
Educational Qualification Details: Fill in your educational qualification details and click Save & Next.
Experience Details: Fill in experience details, if applicable, and click Save & Next.
Upload Photo & Signature: Upload a high-contrast, color, passport-size photo and your scanned signature (in Hindi or English) as per the specified format.
Preview Your Application: Carefully check all the information entered in the earlier steps; use the Back button to correct any errors. Once satisfied, tick the declaration and click "Final Submit".
Payment of Examination Fee: Click the Payment button and complete the fee payment via Credit Card, Debit Card, UPI, or Net Banking (see Application Fee section for amounts).

Download / Print Application Form: After successful payment, download and print your application form and transaction receipt for your own records. A hard copy need not be sent to the Board - it is required only at the time of Document Verification.

A confirmation email is sent to the registered email ID after successful submission. Once submitted, the application cannot be withdrawn, and the fee paid cannot be refunded or charged back (except for a failed transaction, which is auto-refunded). Candidates are advised not to wait until the last date and to complete the process well in advance, as the Board is not responsible for internet or banking-related disruptions.

faq.question: Q1. What is BSFC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a written-exam-based panel-formation recruitment for Bihar State Food & Civil Supplies Corporation Ltd. (BSFC), conducted by BCECEB under the Food & Consumer Protection Department, Government of Bihar, for 259 posts across 5 designations. The panel formed will be valid for one year.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in BSFC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 259 posts: Assistant Manager (81), Assistant Accounts Officer (6), Accountant (11), Quality Controller (38), and Lower Grade Clerk (123).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for BSFC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Online registration closes on 24 September 2026, and fee payment for registered candidates closes on 25 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for BSFC posts?
faq.answer: It varies by post - from a Graduate degree with computer/typing proficiency for Lower Grade Clerk, to an MBA/PGDBM for Assistant Manager. See the Eligibility section for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for BSFC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As on 01 January 2026, the minimum age is 21 years, with maximum age (with relaxation) ranging from 37 years (Unreserved Male) to 42 years (SC/ST), plus a further 10-year relaxation for PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for BSFC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹1,200 for General/EWS/BC/EBC candidates, and ₹600 for SC/ST and PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for BSFC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Online, through bceceboard.bihar.gov.in, via the "Online Portal of Food & Civil Supplies Corporation Ltd." - registration, filling in details, uploading photo/signature, and paying the fee.

faq.question: Q8. Can I correct mistakes in my BSFC application?
faq.answer: Yes, but only during the correction window from 26 to 28 September 2026, by logging in and using the "Edit Details" option.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for BSFC posts?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from PB-1/Grade Pay ₹1,900 (Level-2) for Lower Grade Clerk to ₹9,300–34,800/Grade Pay ₹4,600 (Level-7) for Assistant Manager and Assistant Accounts Officer.

faq.question: Q10. When will the BSFC exam be held?
faq.answer: The exam date and admit card release date are not specified in the notification — candidates are advised to check bceceboard.bihar.gov.in regularly for updates.
